subject.title: fix(commands): bound reset-hook transcript reads to prevent OOM

question: What bounded payload contract should `before_reset` hooks receive when the previous transcript exceeds safe memory limits?
rationale: Actually preventing OOM requires truncating, summarizing, paging, or otherwise changing the current all-messages plugin payload; repository evidence cannot choose that compatibility policy safely.

options.title: Bound recent messages
options.body: Send a documented recent-message window with explicit byte and message ceilings, preserving the newest context while preventing unbounded memory use.

options.title: Add paged hook access
options.body: Keep the event payload bounded and expose a separate reader or paging API for plugins that need older transcript history.

options.title: Keep complete payload
options.body: Retain every previous message and explicitly accept that this hook cannot guarantee bounded memory for arbitrarily large transcripts.

recommendation.title: Bound recent messages
recommendation.body: Send a documented recent-message window with explicit byte and message ceilings, preserving the newest context while preventing unbounded memory use.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the shared transcript reader and index contract whose behavior must be calibrated.
